# nanelo_zones (Data Source)

Lists the zones the API key has access to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nanelo_zones" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `zones` (List of String) Zone names.
